text.text: Maille is the inner chain layer of plate armor. Each plated piece can be built with a maille part on top of the plating, adding extra protection.
The maille only contributes part of its stats: defense, toughness, knockback resistance, hardness, environmental protection, weight and ricochet are added at 50%, and durability at 25%.
Light materials (leather, vine, slime) make a light maille; heavy metals make a heavier, tougher one. Choose the maille to tune the final weight and resistances of your armor.
